# Profile visual reference

`user-profile-reference.html` is a complete, unedited snapshot of:

`experimental/demo/user-profile.html` from the AgentsView source tree, captured
on 2026-07-27 for the avscore visual-contract tests.

The production template intentionally removes the KwAITI identity/mock,
verification-code, and poster-download components. Tests compare every other
base visual rule, the 980 px and 680 px responsive rules, reduced-motion rules,
and the core DOM hierarchy.
